suggest.laravel/prompts: Enables a richer interactive backend for `php tools/ai/ai.php install --wizard`; the installer degrades gracefully to plain stdin prompts without it.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the full PHPUnit suite serially.
scripts-descriptions.test:fast: Run the suite in parallel via paratest (16 procs), excluding the `slow` group (heavy subprocess tests). Fastest feedback lane.
scripts-descriptions.test:slow-suite: Run the full suite in parallel via paratest (16 procs) including the `slow` group (heavy subprocess tests) for complete coverage.
scripts-descriptions.test:slow: Print per-test timing for the last junit profile (run `composer test:profile` first).
scripts-descriptions.test:profile: Run PHPUnit and emit a JUnit XML report at docs/ai/generated/phpunit-junit.xml for slow-test ranking.
